verses.text: Ayik toxo ix sk'ulej masanil juntzanh chi' winhaj Ezequías, yik sk'anab'ajan Jehová winh, ix jawi winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yet' heb' soldado. Ix laj och hoyan heb' t'a spatiktak juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuro'al t'a yol yik Judá, yik syik'anek' heb' yalani.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ezequías chi' to toxo ix jawi winhaj Senaquerib chi' yak' owal t'a Jerusalén,
ix smol halan winh yet' heb' winh yajal yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado to smuk sjajtak ha ha' heb' winh ay t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi'. Ix cha sk'o'ol heb' winh sk'ulan tas ix alchaj chi'.

Yuj chi' te niwan heb' anima chi' ix smolb'ej sb'a, ix laj smukan sjajtak ha ha' chi' heb' yet' ha ha' sb'ey t'a slak'anil chi', yik wach' ayik sjawi heb' asirio chi', manhxalaj ha' tz'ilchaj yuj heb'.

Ix yak' wal yip winhaj rey Ezequías chi' sb'o'anxik'e smuro'al chonhab' chi' b'aj mak'b'ilem lanhnajok. Ix b'ochajxik'e juntzanh b'aj stanhwej heb' soldado t'a yib'anhtak muro yet' junxo muro t'a spatikeli. Te wach' ix ajoch muro b'aj mukb'il jun ch'olan t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Tzijtum k'e'en lanza yet' maklab' jul-lab' ix schek winh rey chi' b'ojok.

Ix yak'anoch yopisio juntzanh heb' winh winak winh yik tz'och heb' winh yajalil t'a masanil chonhab'. Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima t'a sti'el spuerta'il chonhab' chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' to stek'b'ej sb'a heb', ix yalan winh icha tik:

Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, manh hex xiwok, mokab' chab'axk'e he k'o'ol t'a yichanh winh sreyal Asiria chi' yet' t'a jun niwan nhilanh heb' winh soldado yet'nak winh chi', yujto ek'b'al kip t'a yichanh heb' chi'.

Ha winh chi', ha heb' soldado ayoch yipok sk'o'ol winh, palta ha honhxo tik, ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch ket'ok, ha' ol kolwaj ket'ok ayik ol kak'an owal chi', xchi winh. Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima chi' tas ix yal winh rey chi', ix stek'b'an wal sb'a heb'.

Yakb'an wan yak'an owal winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yet' heb' soldado t'a chonhab' Laquis, ix schekankot juntzanh heb' schekab' winh t'a Jerusalén, yik tzul yal heb' t'a winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá yet' t'a masanil heb' aj Judá kajan ta' icha tik:
Icha tik ix yutej winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yalankoti: ¿Mach ayoch yipok he k'o'ol ha hex tik, yuj chi' ayex kan t'a Jerusalén tik, ina to oyb'il hexxo k'e'i?
Tato syal winhaj Ezequías t'ayex to ha Jehová he Diosal ol hex kolanel t'a yol hin k'ab', tonhej tzex yixtej winh, ol hex cham yuj wejel yet' takinhti'al.

¿Tom manhok winhaj Ezequías chi' ix ik'anel juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh yet' altar yik jun Dios chi'? Ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén to junnhej jun altar b'aj snhusji incienso t'a jun Dios chi'.
¿Tom manh heyojtakok tas hin k'ulejnak yet' heb' hin mam wicham t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'? ¿Tokwal ix yal yuj sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi' skolanel heb' t'a yol hin k'ab'?

¿Tom ay junok t'a juntzanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' ix satel heb' hin mam wicham chi' ix yal skolanel schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' heb'? ¿Tas yuj tze na' to ha he Diosal chi' ol hex kolan t'a yol hin k'ab'?

Yuj chi', manh heyak' he b'a musansatil yuj winhaj Ezequías chi'. Manh he cha heyab' tas syal winh. Yujto malaj junok sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix yal skolan schonhab' t'a yol hin k'ab'. Hanhejtona' malaj pax juntzanh Dios chi' ix yal skolan sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb' hin mam wicham. Okxo jun he Diosal chi'. ¿Tom hato wal ol yal hex skolan t'a yol hin k'ab'? xchikot winh, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanhxo tas ix yal heb' schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi' yik sb'uchwaj heb' t'a Jehová Dios yet' t'a winhaj Ezequías haton schekab'.

Ix stz'ib'anpaxkot jun yumal winhaj Senaquerib chi' yik sb'uchwajkot winh t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel. Ha t'a jun yu'um winh chi', ix yalkot winh icha tik: Ha juntzanh sdiosal juntzanhxo chonhab', maj yal-laj skolan schonhab' heb' chi' t'a yol hin k'ab', icha pax chi' sDiosal winhaj Ezequías, manh ol yal-laj skolan schonhab' t'a yol hin k'ab', xchikot winh t'a yu'um chi'.

Ha heb' schekab' winhaj Senaquerib chi', te cha'anh ix yal heb' t'a heb' anima ay t'a Jerusalén chi', haton heb' linhjab'k'e t'a yib'anh muro, te cha'anh ix yal heb' t'a hebreo, yik xib'taj heb' anima chi' yuj heb', yik syak'an ganar Jerusalén chi' heb' yalani.
Ix slajb'ej wal sDiosal Jerusalén heb' yet' juntzanh komon Dios b'ob'il yuj anima, sdiosal juntzanhxo chonhab'.
Yuj wal jun lolonel chi', ix lesalwi winhaj rey Ezequías yet' winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios yuninal winhaj Amoz. Ix sk'anan skolwal Jehová heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ha Jehová ix chekankot jun ángel yik tzul satanel heb' soldado te tek'an, heb' yajalil heb' yet' heb' sat yaj t'a scampamento winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Yuj chi' te k'ixwelalxonhej ix aj smeltzajxi winh rey chi' t'a schonhab'. Haxo yik ix och winh t'a yol stemplo sdiosal, ha heb' yuninal winh ix milanchamok.

Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová skolan winhaj Ezequías chi' yet' masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria chi', yet' pax t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanhxo chonhab'. Junk'olal ix laj aj heb' yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil chi'.

Yuj chi', tzijtum heb' ix yik'kot yofrenda t'a Jerusalén, ix yak'an heb' t'a Jehová, ix yak'anpax silab' heb' te caro stojol t'a winhaj Ezequías chi'. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', te ow yak'an syahelal winhaj Ezequías chi', ijan ix cham winh. Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wi Jehová chi', ix sch'oxan jun yechel t'a winh te satub'tak yilji, yik sch'oxani to ol b'oxok sk'o'ol winh.

Wach'chom jantak wach'il ix scha winhaj Ezequías chi', palta maj yak' yuj diosal winh t'a Jehová, to ix yik'cha'anh sb'a winh. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a winh yet' t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén.
Yuj chi' ix yik'xi'em sb'a winh yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' t'a yichanh Dios. Yuj chi' majxo yak'kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová chi' t'a yib'anh heb' yakb'an pitzanto winh.

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi', ix te aj sb'eyumal winh, niwan ix aj yelk'och winh. Te niwan k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro, k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji, perfume, maklab' jul-lab' yet' pax masanil tas to ay stojol ix smolb'ej winh.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok spatil b'aj sik'chaj ixim trigo, wino yet' aceite. Ix b'ochaj pax smakte' nok' wakax, nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok juntzanh chonhab', yujto manh jantakok nok' swakax winh yet' nok' skalnel. Te niwan sb'eyumal winh ix yak' Dios.

Haton winh ix chekan makchaj sjaj ha' Gihón t'a yib'anh, yik wach' haxo t'a yalanh lu'um sb'ey ha'. Ha t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a schonhab' winhaj David, hata' ix k'och ha'. Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach'nhej ix elk'ochi.

Ha heb' winh yajal t'a Babilonia, ix schekkot heb' winh schekab' heb' winh yik tzul sk'anb'an heb' winh yuj jun tas satub'tak ix uji t'a Judá. Ix aktajkan winhaj Ezequías chi' yuj Dios sch'okoj yik tz'ak'ji prowal winh yuj, yik syila' tas yaj spensar winh.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Ezequías yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' b'aj ix sk'anab'ajej Dios winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan tas yilnak winhaj Isaías yuninal winhaj Amoz yet' t'a yumal yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá yet' Israel.

Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a yib'anhk'e b'aj mukb'il heb' yinhtilal winhaj David. Masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén, ix sch'oxel heb' to niwan yelk'och winh ayik ix smukan winh chi heb', haxo winhaj Manasés yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
